review.scope: REC-124-C02, REC-124-C04, REC-124-C06, REC-124-D04, REC-124-D06 and REC-124-H05 fixture corrections
findings: Revision 1 was frozen before observation and remains immutable.

C02 introduced two stale consumers when the inner CityOut declaration changed, so its first revision produced two roots and its second revision was quiet; the corrected fixture retains one CityOut consumer and one NameOut consumer.
C04 and D04 mutated an unused inner CityOut declaration, so the first revision was quiet; each corrected fixture consumes both exported outputs exactly once.

C06 and D06 mutated nested inner declarations that produced multiple downstream roots and, in revision 1, an additional invalid-expression diagnostic; revision 2 mutates one outer consumer at a time while retaining nested CTE/derived structure.
H05 revision 1 had an unrelated non-aggregate warning in its valid seed; revision 2 uses an aggregate plus predicate trajectory with no unrelated diagnostic.

sourceJustification.revision1Observation: Changing the inner CityOut export left both p.CityOut references unresolved, while repairing it and changing NameOut did not leave the declared single-root shape.
sourceJustification.correction: Keep the same CTE output-renaming trajectory but use p.CityOut as the sole CityOut consumer and p.NameOut as the sole NameOut consumer.
sourceJustification.reason: The correction makes each successive revision observe exactly one current root without suppressing either stale diagnostic.

sourceJustification.revision1Observation: The first mutation renamed an output that was not consumed by the query, so no diagnostic was produced.
sourceJustification.correction: Use a single CityOut consumer and a distinct NameOut predicate consumer in each fixture.
sourceJustification.reason: Both declared output edits are now observable at their owning consumer boundary.

sourceJustification.revision1Observation: Renaming nested inner declarations produced multiple downstream roots and MQ3027_InvalidExpressionType in addition to the declared unknown-column root.
sourceJustification.correction: Retain nested CTE/derived structure and mutate the unique outer q/x consumer references one at a time.
sourceJustification.reason: The fixture continues to exercise nested output scope while isolating the declared successive correction boundary.

sourceJustification.revision1Observation: The valid seed select Sum(a.Population), a.City had the unrelated MQ3012_NonAggregateInSelect warning.
sourceJustification.correction: Use select Sum(a.Population) with a.City as the independent predicate root.
sourceJustification.reason: The valid seed is now warning-free while preserving two independently corrected roots.

fixtureCorrections: All 48 case identifiers and eight six-case families remain present.
The final test retains exact step diagnostics, phases, source domains, spans, same-token shift checks and stale-error removal checks.

productionFindings.title: Lexer trimmed the analyzed document before assigning token spans
productionFindings.observation: A two-space document prefix left the retained diagnostic at its old offset instead of shifting it by two UTF-16 code units.
productionFindings.rootCause: Musoq.Parser.Lexer assigned input.Trim() to Input while QueryAnalyzer retained the original query in SourceText.
productionFindings.fix: Lexer now retains the exact input string; its existing whitespace-token skipping preserves parsing behavior while keeping token and diagnostic offsets in the original document coordinate system.
